correctness.rationale: For the product geodesic metric, D² is the sum of squares of independent uniform half-circumference displacement and triangular height difference. Direct integration proves all three polynomial moments. The quadratic candidate roots have sum 7/11 and their cubic difference factors into a nonzero multiple of (x-y) times a strictly positive quadratic. Exact fold endpoints, excluded degenerate boundary and smooth inverse are checked. Symbolic verification and independent numerical quadratures in verify.py agree.

value.rationale: A complete inverse classification of a natural two-parameter family of compact flat manifolds with boundary is obtained using only three unlabeled intrinsic distance moments. The sharp two-moment ambiguity and exact open fold region show the third statistic is genuinely necessary, while global uniqueness plus smooth local inversion identify all positive dimensions. This is motivated by intrinsic distance-histogram geometric identification, not arbitrary parameter choice.
